Need more steel? Well, look no further. The §bSteam Molten Steel Furnace§f is used to process §aSteel§f much easier and faster than a §9PBF§f but you must run the liquid steel as an input into a §aStrand Caster§e to get the actual products.

§fThe main drawback of this machine is that you need §cbriquettes§f as fuel, which can be a power-intensive process.

§9Additionally, the inputs must be in Dust form.
